# V2.4.0 - Watcher

- **Run → Monitor:** Watch a specific GitHub Actions run or a supported local MCP completion event. Results stay in Monitor unless you opt in to a short, tool-free reply in the original saved chat. Watches are local to the running desktop process and do not resume after a restart.
- **Desktop tray:** Keep Fate available after closing the window; quit from the tray to stop the app.
- **Work → Files:** Preview Word `.docx` paragraphs and headings and save notes for that document revision without editing the file.
- **Work → Changes:** Save a local note on changed lines and check GitHub PR status for the current commit. A previous result or note is marked stale when its revision changes. The review controls do not post, merge, or push.

See [Features](https://github.com/Master0fFate/fateUI/blob/v2.4.0/docs/features.md) and [MCP](https://github.com/Master0fFate/fateUI/blob/v2.4.0/docs/mcp.md) for setup and limits.
